title: A Whole World Takes Shape with Your Words! 🌍
body: A Whole World Takes Shape with Your Words! 🌍

Google announced on 18 November that its new Genie 4 model is now available inside Project Genie. The world model is an AI system that builds a virtual 3D world you can wander through, like a video game created by AI moment by moment.

The new thing here is that you can change this world while you're inside it: write a sentence and it changes the weather, adds a character or turns the story in a new direction, while the model also adds sounds, music and dialogue that change with the scene.

The service is available now only to Google AI Ultra subscribers, while AI Pro subscribers join a waitlist. And although the idea is dazzling, Google still considers it experimental research, and admits to issues such as camera lag and weak long-term scene continuity.
If you could build your own world with a single sentence, what would it be? 💭
